method: Canonical baseline from the 2026-08-08 audit (Lighthouse 13.4.1, live site, mobile Moto G Power profile 4x CPU / 1.6 Mbps / 150 ms RTT; desktop preset). The published bundle was verified byte-identical to local dist-assets/ (md5 match, index/main.js/style.css). Warm-visit transfer measured against the live site via headless Chromium + CDP (Network.clearBrowserCache, then two navigations; same-origin resource timing bytes). Local nginx measurements were captured but are not canonical: network throttling does not behave like the edge and concurrent runs added variance.

warm_visit_live.finding: Warm visit transfers ~= cold visit. No caching benefit: pmtiles no-store, text assets max-age=0. The favicon 404 (2 KB) disappears on the warm run only because the browser stops requesting it after the first 404.

warm_visit_note: Local headless Chromium (Arch build 150) does not exercise the HTTP cache in this environment (verified: repeated fetch() re-downloads; disk-cache flags ineffective). Warm-visit byte verification is therefore deferred to the deployed site (quickstart S7 / T019), where real user browsers and the edge apply. Local verification covers header correctness only.
